exposure: Type of noncephalic second twin presentation (breech vs. transverse)
Gestational age at delivery (before vs. after 37 weeks)
cohort: 3903 second twins born ≥32 weeks of gestation after vaginal delivery of the first twin
finding: Noncephalic and cephalic second twin presentations after vaginal delivery of the first twin ≥32 weeks of gestation are associated with similar low composite neonatal mortality and morbidity.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery rates for the second twin were lower in the breech group compared to the cephalic group and lower in the cephalic group compared to the transverse group.
